library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

Exercise - using functions
```{r}
#Rounding 3.14159 to the nearest whole number
round(3.14159)
```

Exercise - Argument order
```{r}
#Arguments in order
print(rep(5, 7))

#Names
print(rep(x = 5, times = 7))
```

Exercise - Character, numerical and logical variables
```{r}
#Character
a <- "Jacqueline"

#Numeric
b <- 7

#Logical
c <- TRUE

print(class(a))
print(class(b))
print(class(c))
```

Exercise - Using variables of different types
```{r}
cell_id_1 <- "CX1"
cell_id_2 <- "CX2"

treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_2 <- FALSE

num_cells_before_1 <- 5415
num_cells_before_2 <- 8123

num_cells_after_1 <- 1432
num_cells_after_2 <- 7543

cell_id <- c(cell_id_1, cell_id_2)
treated <- c(treated_1, treated_2)
num_cells_before <- c(num_cells_before_1, num_cells_before_2)
num_cells_after <- c(num_cells_after_1, num_cells_after_2)
```

Exercise - Indexing
```{r}
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
print(all_my_pets[4])
```

Exercise - Creating a data frame
```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(
    cellID = cell_id,
    treated_ones = treated,
    num_cells_b = num_cells_before,
    num_cells_a = num_cells_after
)

gt(my_data_frame)
```
